chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Al-Halabi from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him): In

the young girl whom her father maries off without her consent, he (peace be upon him) said: 'She has no authority with her father once he marries her off; her marriage is valid even if she is unwilling.'

key_terms.اَلْجَارِيَة: The young girl (often implying a minor or young unmarried woman)
key_terms.يُزَوِّجُهَا: He marries her off (arranges her marriage)

ai.seo_question: Is a father's arrangement of marriage valid for his young daughter without her consent in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the authority of the father (wali) in contracting the marriage of a young minor, establishing that his decision is legally binding even if the daughter is displeased. It highlights the Shia juristic view that while consent is preferred, the father's guardianship right supersedes the minor's objection in cases of valid marriage contracts, distinguishing it from the ruling for a mature woman who retains full autonomy.
